stories.title: Miami survives two Hail Marys, leaving FSU without answers in 2OT thriller
stories.summary: Darian Mensah threw for 326 yards and three touchdowns, and No. 3 Miami held on to beat archrival Florida State 43-35 in double overtime Saturday night.

stories.title: Rays capitalize on Guardians' errors to even ALCS at 2-2
stories.summary: Junior Caminero, Yandy Diaz and Jonathan Aranda combined to go 6-for-14 with five RBIs as the Rays tied the ALCS at 2-2 with Saturday's 7-3 win over Cleveland.

stories.title: 'Emotional' Sitake reminiscent after BYU's upset of Notre Dame
stories.summary: With a defensive stop that concluded in the end zone on the game's final play, No. 8 BYU outlasted No. 2 Notre Dame to preserve a riveting 28-24 victory Saturday, the Fighting Irish's first loss of the season and a win that moved to Cougars to 6-0.

stories.title: Gabby Williams comes up clutch as Valkyries 'find a way' in Game 1
stories.summary: The Valkyries hold off the Dream 68-64 in Game 1 of the WNBA Finals.

stories.title: Auburn stuns No. 1 Georgia after Stockton's fumble dooms Bulldogs
stories.summary: Auburn, led by QB Byrum Brown's dominant running game, upset No. 1 Georgia after taking advantage of a key fumble by Gunner Stockton with 58 seconds left.
